kitEvidence.formula:
Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Units that are Ablaze take [(75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.7) × AP) × (1.25)] damage instead.

builds.name: Blaze: one three-stack health explosion
builds.summary: Investigate high one three-stack Blaze detonation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one three-stack Blaze detonation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The detonation helper uses the level-scaled 6%-12% base plus 0.02 percentage points per AP of enemy maximum HP. AP therefore increases a target-health coefficient, while MR modifiers affect the magic blast. The ordinary four-second Blaze burn is a separate effect. No neighboring Brand explosions or repeat-stacking chain is silently added.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists; stop observed scoring when a target dies and report raw overkill separately. Exactly three legally applied Blaze stacks, one detonation after the source two-second delay; score one victim only. Preparation spell damage and burn excluded. Riftmaker already ramped before the explosion. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Prior champion combat 4s does not automatically grant arbitrary item stacks.

kitEvidence.formula:
Brand's Abilities light his targets Ablaze, dealing [2]% max Health magic damage over 4 seconds. If Brand kills a unit that is Ablaze, he regains [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 3, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3329999446868896, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 18, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] mana. Blaze can stack up to 3 times.

When a champion or large jungle monster reaches 3 stacks, the Blaze will detonate after 2 seconds, dealing [(characterLevelInterpolation(6 → 12; raw flags preserved) + (0.02) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to surrounding enemies.
